limitations: The study supports receptor-dependent function but does not provide a purified EFNB1-EPHB3 affinity measurement; endogenous EphB-family contributions and transformed-cell context remain. No SCI model or terminal TF was measured.

limitations: No direct or receptor-specific EFNB1-EPHB4 evidence was retained. Expression, EphB4-family membership, and EFNB2-EPHB4 signaling do not establish EFNB1 engagement or downstream function; no terminal TF assigned.
